instruction.text: Suno hält eine Präsentation über einen Nationalpark der USA. Beantworte die Frage.

atoms.a: What would be the most fitting introduction for Suno's presentation?
atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>What would be the most fitting introduction for Suno's presentation?</voice>

b.sound: Hello everyone. Today I am going to talk to you about Denali National Park.
Well... I slept so badly. I cannot wait until I'm back home.
So... Today, we will be looking at some interesting things about modern technology.
Hey everyone. Um, right. So, I only started preparing yesterday, so my presentation won't be as long as the others.

instruction.text: Höre dir den Auszug aus der Präsentation an. Zu welchem Teil der Präsentation gehört er? Wähle aus.

atoms.b: “First, I will talk about the history of the park. I will then deal with the ecology of the park. After that, I will introduce you to the geological features of the region. Finally, I will give you a summary, and we can discuss some questions I prepared.”

instruction.text: Welche Folie ist übersichtlicher? Wähle sie aus.

atoms.a: Why is this slide better for a presentation?
b: ++good layout of title, text and picture

instruction.text: Sieh dir die Folie an und höre der Präsentation zu.

hint.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>inhabit</voice> bedeutet bewohnen, <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>caribou</voice> bedeutet Karibu, <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>antler</voice> bedeutet Geweih

atoms.b: “Denali National Park is home to lots of different animals. For example, around 3,000 black and brown bears live there. On the mountainside, you can find Dall sheep. Smaller animals like coyotes or beavers are living in the region as well. The park is also inhabited by thousands of caribou and moose. The picture on my slide shows a caribou with big antlers searching for food.”

instruction.text: Welches Bild sollte Suno in seiner Präsentation verwenden, um den Park zu beschreiben?

atoms.b: “The picture shows the different ((++landscapes animals)) of Denali National Park. ((++In_the_foreground In_the_background)), there is a small river and a stony river bank. In the centre, there is a big ((++forest lake)) which is the habitat for many animals. In the background, there is a ((++mountain_range desert)) with Denali in its centre. It is the largest mountain in the USA.”

atoms.a: What would be a better conclusion for Suno's presentation?
atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>What would be a better conclusion for Suno's presentation?</voice>

b.sound: As you can see, the landscapes and the wildlife of Denali National Park are very impressive. To conclude my presentation I would like to ask you: Would you ever want to visit this park and, if yes, why? But first: R there any questions?
All in all, it was hard to get any information on that park. I found it a little boring as well. So, do you have any questions?
